extension.description: Run, debug and build .NET, run Node.js, PHP, Python and Docker projects, and let AI assistants drive them. Created by Camilo Ruiz · acrocode.dev.
trust.description: Running and building requires a trusted workspace.
dotpilot.compile.label: Build & test
dotpilot.launchOptions.label: Project
dotpilot.buildScope.description: Build the solution (choose if there are several) or the startup project.
dotpilot.dotnetPath.description: Path to the dotnet executable, without arguments.
dotpilot.showStatusBar.description: Show controls in the status bar.
dotpilot.openBrowser.description: Open the browser when the profile requests launchBrowser and the app is ready.
dotpilot.showEditorToolbar.description: Show the run controls and DotPilot menu in the editor title bar.
dotpilot.browser.description: Browser for the app. Edge and Chrome use a separate temporary profile and close when the project stops.
dotpilot.browser.enum.0: Linked Edge window: closing it stops the project.
dotpilot.browser.enum.1: Linked Chrome window: closing it stops the project.
dotpilot.browser.enum.2: Default browser: closing it does not stop the project.
dotpilot.language.description: Language of the DotPilot panel and messages. Automatic follows the VS Code language.
dotpilot.browsers.label: Web browser
dotpilot.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python executable. Leave empty to use the project virtual environment (.venv, venv, env) or the system Python.
dotpilot.phpPath.description: Path to the PHP executable, without arguments.
dotpilot.tool.list_projects.name: List projects
dotpilot.tool.list_projects.description: Lists the runnable projects in the workspace and their profiles.
dotpilot.tool.get_status.name: Get status
dotpilot.tool.get_status.description: Shows what is running, the server URL and the result of the last operation.
dotpilot.tool.select_project.name: Select project
dotpilot.tool.select_profile.name: Select profile
dotpilot.tool.select_profile.description: Chooses the launch profile (.NET profile, npm script, server or Compose service).
dotpilot.tool.run.name: Run project
dotpilot.tool.run.description: Runs the selected project without debugging.
dotpilot.tool.debug.name: Debug .NET project
dotpilot.tool.debug.description: Builds and starts the .NET project under the C# debugger.
dotpilot.tool.hot_reload.name: Run with Hot Reload
dotpilot.tool.hot_reload.description: Runs the .NET project with dotnet watch.
dotpilot.tool.stop.name: Stop
dotpilot.tool.stop.description: Stops the run or debug session started by DotPilot.
dotpilot.tool.restart.name: Restart
dotpilot.tool.restart.description: Stops and starts the current run again in the same mode.
dotpilot.tool.build.name: Build or test (.NET)
dotpilot.tool.build.description: Builds, cleans, restores, tests or analyzes the .NET project or solution.
dotpilot.tool.open_browser.name: Open in browser
dotpilot.tool.open_browser.description: Opens the app in the selected browser.
dotpilot.tool.get_output.name: Get output
dotpilot.tool.get_output.description: Returns the last output lines of the app started with Run or Hot Reload.
dotpilot.tool.get_problems.name: Get problems
dotpilot.tool.get_problems.description: Returns the errors and warnings from the VS Code Problems panel.
dotpilot.assistantsEnabled.description: Let AI assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot) use DotPilot through a local bridge that only listens on this computer.
dotpilot.assistantsPermission.descriptio: ask: confirm each time an assistant runs, restarts or builds. allow: run without asking.
dotpilot.laragonPath.description: Laragon install folder (for example C:\laragon). Leave empty to detect it from the project or common locations.
